purpose: Art-direction guidance, not a fixed template or a claim about ranking algorithms.

references.source: Ali Abdaal — This Man Changed Productivity Forever
references.evidence: Actual public video sampled across its duration.
references.observations: Large concept words and illustrative scenes carry emphasis; small dialogue captions serve a separate role. The visual treatment changes with the idea rather than displaying a permanent project-name label.

references.evidence: Public creator-published stills and animated sequences; not a claim about a current TikTok feed.
references.observations: Large typography, size contrast and timed reveals create hierarchy. Words and creator footage alternate in prominence. Adapt the principle to the audience; an older reflective audience does not need this campaign's rapid motion or neon colors.

references.source: Meta — New Ways to Create Content on Instagram
references.evidence: Official Reels editing and typography screenshots; some individual Instagram reels were inaccessible without login.
references.observations: Weight, font character, outline and placement can establish readable text over footage. A translucent rectangle is one option, not the default treatment for every text role.

Keep important content readable within the interface safe area. Safe areas depend on format and UI; the supplied project bounds are a conservative production choice, not a universal official pixel specification.

design_decisions_required: State a visual concept suited to the actual subject and audience. Select a coherent type hierarchy, palette, contrast method and motion pace.
Separate project metadata from the audience-facing hook. Write a short readable headline with intentional line breaks, decide its display interval, and give it enough visual prominence.
Give headline, narration captions and optional chapter words distinct roles. Avoid repeating the same long sentence in multiple layers or leaving a small title badge on every frame by habit.
Inspect the supplied media contact sheet. Place text in negative space and preserve the subject's face or meaningful action.
Use restrained emphasis and purposeful motion. Different content can use cinematic type, editorial composition or bold explainers; no single layout is mandatory.
For a redesign, describe concrete changes from the previous result and implement them. Reused media does not authorize reusing a rejected layout.
